summary: The diff introduces documentation and metadata for a Version 17 deployment, but it also includes application code changes (frontend and backend), which violates the “deployment only / no functionality changes” constraint. Additionally, there is no evidence in the diff that Version 17 was actually deployed and made active, nor that a live URL was provided/confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Publish/deploy application Version 17 to the live environment (production) and make it the active version users see.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff only adds a deployment runbook and a deployment-info metadata file; it does not provide evidence of an actual production deployment (e.g., release config, CI/CD changes, or confirmation artifacts) or that Version 17 is now the active version served to users.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide a live URL (or confirmation of the existing live URL) for verification.
missing_requirements.reason: The deployment metadata explicitly leaves the live URL unconfirmed (placeholder text), and no other file in the diff summary provides/confirm a production URL.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend application logic changes in backend/main.mo despite the request being deployment-only with no application functionality/code modifications.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly constrains changes to deployment only; modifying backend code is out of scope and risks functionality changes.
